column1: # Intel CPU only. Selected by $CPU_VENDOR in bootstrap.sh, not by machine.
# NB: these rows lived in reliability.tsv until the desktop arrived, where they
# are not merely useless but actively noisy - thermald refuses to start on an
# AMD CPU, so system/apply.sh warned "could not enable thermald.service" on
# every single run and nothing in doctor.sh ever noticed. Splitting by CPU
# vendor is what makes that silence impossible.

column5: Intel's thermal daemon. Whiskey Lake (i5-8365U) is exactly its target platform. It has no AMD support at all - do not move this back into reliability.tsv

NOT installed: intel_lpmd(8) is for hybrid P-core/E-core CPUs. The i5-8365U is 4 homogeneous cores with no E-cores, so its default config selects a cpuset that does not exist here. Do not "fix" this back in.
